A large part of the day-to-day involves staying in regular contact with stakeholders across technical and business teams to keep the platform running smoothly.
cond_0267.responsibilities:
Plan and execute Enterprise server deployments, both on-premises and cloud-based.
Configure authentication options for the platform.
Monitor, maintain, and scale server deployments to meet business requirements.
Automate server monitoring and maintenance tasks.
Investigate and resolve complex server issues, connecting with relevant teams early to clarify the problem and work toward a fix.
Install and configure Power BI Report Server.
Migrate SSRS reports to the Power BI platform.
Perform server maintenance tasks such as backups, updates, and restores.
Monitor server performance and usage, and communicate findings to stakeholders regularly.
Manage all sites, users, groups, and content within the Power BI platform.
Troubleshoot production issues and utilize expertise in software and tools for monitoring server and application health, remediating server vulnerabilities, and managing production releases — actively raising issues and walking teams through remediation steps.
Create site users and groups, as well as projects, and organize site content.
Assign content permissions to users and groups.
Monitor and maintain site metrics including content usage, user activity, and scheduled tasks, sharing updates with relevant stakeholders on an ongoing basis.
Troubleshoot user issues within a site, handling questions directly and keeping users informed throughout.
cond_0267.requirements:
Power BI Report Server architecture and administration expertise.
Proficiency with Report Server and its metadata in SQL Server.
Experience acting as a platform administrator for Power BI.
Ability to automate application administration tasks and operating procedures.
Advanced skill and experience with Power BI development and administration.
Proficient in querying languages such as ANSI-SQL and T-SQL.
Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills to assist Production Support in issue resolution.
Ability to actively champion business intelligence principles with stakeholders including business owners, application owners, data analysts, and DBAs — initiating discussions, explaining trade-offs, and clarifying requirements as needed.
Capability to handle multiple projects while meeting deadlines and documenting progress.
Strong communication skills to interface regularly with technical and business leaders within the organization.
Self-starter with leadership capabilities.
Comprehensive understanding of the Agile Development process.
Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field.
